name: Nylo
summary: A social humanoid from a San Jose startup, built around IntEngine — a system that fuses vision, audio and language in real time to read social cues and intent, then coordinates speech, expression and gesture without a script. It works airports, hotel lobbies and conference floors in over 50 languages; a unit named José greets travellers at San José Mineta International Airport.
notable: Deployed at San José Mineta International Airport
Ran an entire unattended CES 2026 booth on its own
